name: Amethyst crystal scan
author: Eydeet
fit: Half-buried purple crystal beside a shaded rock, with restrained inner glow.
caveat: A 1,000-triangle scan; add glow through our material, not a large light.
downloadNote: Official download may require a free Sketchfab account; no model downloaded in this review.

name: Natural amethyst specimen
author: RISD Nature Lab
fit: A subtle mineral discovery tucked into the forest rocks, with a restrained magical highlight.

name: Crystal cluster
author: WinterPrison
fit: A few pale blue crystals around one remote island formation.

name: Woodland fairy
author: Jels
fit: One small fairy drifting above the wooded path or beside the pink tree.

name: Animated crow

name: Flying seagull

name: Ancient runestone
